subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about completed-ride acquisition in your UK cities. Since 2 January 2026 closed the TOMS loophole and forced London operators to charge 20 percent VAT on the full fare, fares are up an estimated 2 to 3 pounds on a 12 pound trip, squeezing the price-sensitive first ride {Brand} relies on. With new-rider acquisition running roughly 30 to 50 pounds, optimizing to the validated completed ride and proving it incremental against a holdout protects your real cost per rider. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: UK TOMS VAT change (2 Jan 2026) + ride-hailing rider-CAC band
